claims.value: Bodart: side A (French)about 6,000 men; side B (Russian)about 12,000 men.
claims.rationale: Read on the registered page image. His general rule is forces disposable for the engagement, rounded upward (shared research-conventions index); a stated siege endpoint or engaged subset takes precedence over treating it as an opening count. Population/timing alternatives are not reconciled. English rendering (ours): "Russian victory (about 12,000 men) under Lieutenant-General Dochtorow over the French (about 6,000 men) under Marshal Soult."

claims.value: Bodart lists side A under Marschall Soult; side B under Gen.-Lt. Dochtorow.
claims.rationale: Printed attribution, not automatic allocation of tactical or campaign credit. claims.rationale: Retains the frozen winner convention. A capitulation date and physical handover can differ; historical source disputes remain separate. claims.value: Side A: Höpfner has one 57th-line battalion and 4 guns under Ferey initially in the works, with another light battalion in the wood; the 46th, the 57th’s other battalion and later 12 heavy guns were sent up.
claims.rationale: Staged formations, not people totals; do not add to Bodart’s 6,000. English rendering (ours): "One battalion of the 57th Infantry Regiment and 4 guns under Ferey defended the redoubts" English rendering (ours): "From there the commander sent the 46th Infantry Regiment and the 57th’s 2nd battalion to Ferey after the first cannonshots, and later twelve 12-pounders."

citations.quote: Ein Bataillon des 57. Infanterie-Regiments und 4 Kanonen unter dem General Ferey vertheidigten die Schanzen
von wo der Führer nach den ersten Kanonenschüssen das 46. Infanterie-Regiment und das 2. Bataillon des 57. Regiments, und später noch 12—12pfünder zum General Ferey vorgehen ließ.

claims.value: Side B: the French bulletin describes two Russian divisions attacking, without a numerical people count.
claims.rationale: No conversion from nominal divisions to men. English rendering (ours): "Two Russian divisions of the centre were simultaneously attacking Lomitten’s bridgehead."

citations.quote: Deux divisions russes du centre attaquaient au même moment la tête de pont de Lomitten.

claims.value: The French bulletin assigns local defence to Ferey’s brigade in Soult’s corps; Höpfner describes Dochtorow directing part of his forces toward Elditten during the battle.
claims.rationale: Soult’s superior corps authority differs from Ferey’s immediate defence; no automatic full-side attribution. English rendering (ours): "Ferey’s brigade of Soult’s corps defended this position." English rendering (ours): "During the Lomitten action Dochtorow marched left with part of his forces via Kalkstein toward Elditten"

citations.quote: La brigade du général Ferey, du corps du maréchal Soult, défendait cette position.
Der General Dochtorow war während des Gefechts bei Lomitten mit einem Theil seiner Kräfte über Kalkstein auf Elditten links abmarschirt

claims.value: Side A held bridgehead redoubts, an outlying work and an abatis.
claims.rationale: Newly built bridge does not establish who ordered the fieldworks. English rendering (ours): "There was a bridgehead immediately before the newly built bridge" English rendering (ours): "The abatis and works remain covered with Russians."

citations.quote: Es befand sich hier ein Brückenkopf unmittelbar vor der neu erbauten Brücke
Les abatis et les ouvrages restent couverts de Russes.

claims.value: The bridge crossed the Passarge; Höpfner describes works on both valley sides and a wooded abatis.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "while an abatis in the wood below on the Passarge flanked the attackers."

citations.quote: während ein Verhau in dem Gehölze unterhalb an der Passarge die Angreifenden flankirte.

claims.value: Side B attacked the French bridgehead.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "Two Russian divisions attacked Lomitten’s bridgehead."

citations.quote: Deux divisions russes du centre attaquaient au même moment la tête de pont de Lomitten.

claims.value: The French bulletin says the defenders repulsed the Russians all day; this conflicts with Bodart’s Russian victory.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "The 46th,57th and 24th light infantry repulsed the enemy throughout the day."

citations.quote: Le 46e, le 57e et le 24e d’infanterie légère repoussèrent l’ennemi pendant toute la journée.

claims.value: Höpfner describes Russian capture of the abatis/bridge redoubts and French retreat to the left bank; fire from the further work stopped further Russian advance.
claims.rationale: Limited territorial gain is not campaign success. English rendering (ours): "and ended with French retreat to the Passarge’s left bank. Fire from the work on the left valley edge stopped the Russians’ further advance." English rendering (ours): "with capture of the abatis, largely burned down by Russian shell fire, and the bridge redoubts"

citations.quote: und mit dem Rückzuge der Franzosen auf das linke Ufer der Passarge endete. Das Feuer des auf dem linken Thalrande belegenen Werkes machte dem weitern Vordringen der Russen ein Ende.
